scenarios: Reuse may be validA bookkeeping-only commit does not force re-execution. The required inputs must still be equivalent, retained bytes intact and the evaluator qualified.

The runner proof becomes staleChanging an external script, interpreter or declared tool dependency invalidates affected proof and exceptions whose risk depends on it. Preserve the old result; obtain current evidence.

A qualified delta can supplement earlier proofAn independent assessment must cover changed scope and interactions, refer to valid earlier proof and resolve affected findings. A new SHA alone does not force a full repeat.

Missing bytes cannot support passageAn old PASS event is insufficient when its referenced evidence is gone. Restore exact bytes and revalidate, or obtain fresh qualifying proof. Do not reconstruct history from current files.
